texts.head: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Lapland, 18 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 12 patients a year.
texts.wait: Lapland's patients do not wait longer: 31.2 days from diagnosis to treatment in the OYS area, 36.9 in Finland. Fewer are treated to cure. Measured · Cancer Registry 2018–mid 2022 · p. 28 · read by Gemini · Published for the collaborative area, not for the county.
